description: Choose which of this account's two API keys the server authenticates with from now on: test (sandbox — no real money) or live (the production starter: wallet_read + wallet_write, i.e. the wallet tools). Both keys already belong to the account register_account created on this machine — nothing is minted and no secret is shown; the choice is saved and survives restarts, and the wallet picks it up on its next call. Under live, wallet_create_deposit produces REAL Pix charges and wallet_create_withdrawal moves real money: confirm with the operator before switching. If DEPIX_API_KEY is set in the environment it still OVERRIDES the choice, and the response says so.

mode.description: Which key to activate: test (sandbox) or live (production starter).

name: activate_key

active_key_source.description: Which credential the server actually authenticates with now: "store" = the key just activated, "env" = DEPIX_API_KEY, "owner" = the operator's own login (selected with `account use owner`).

env_override.description: true when DEPIX_API_KEY shadows the activated key.

warning.description: A loud note when the activated key is not the one in use, else null.

title: Activate the sandbox or live key
